title: linkSegments
responsibility: Finds explicit HTTP and HTTPS URLs in plain text and preserves the surrounding text.

inputs.name: linkSegments.text
inputs.description: Plain text to scan for HTTP and HTTPS URLs.

inputs.name: hasWebLink.text
inputs.description: Plain text to check for at least one HTTP or HTTPS URL.

outputs.name: linkSegments
outputs.description: Returns ordered text and URL segments without losing adjacent punctuation.

outputs.name: hasWebLink
outputs.description: Returns true when at least one supported URL can be linked.
